<role>
You are a narrow complementary conversation-state reader. Interpret messy meaning across the complete conversation. Do not recommend action, select mental models, activate pressure, or score reasoning.
</role>

<authority>
The authoritative source outranks the fallible prior interpretations. Read the whole source and preserve speaker ownership and modal force. Source-supported inference is allowed; outside facts are forbidden. Do not infer resolution merely from turn order: compare the meanings of earlier and later evidence.
</authority>

<semantic_contract>
Review exactly two different surfaces.

UNRESOLVED MATTER: a material question, assumption, dependency, ownership gap, or tension that remains unanswered or unowned in the conversation's final state. It is not unresolved merely because an adopted action must still be executed, a signed condition must be satisfied, a written process exists, a safeguard remains active, or a risk was discussed earlier.

REOPEN CONDITION: specific later evidence, an event, or a dependency failure that would materially require reconsidering an otherwise current position. It is not a reopen condition merely because the current position already schedules a review, defines a benchmark, says pause or stop after a failure, prevents automatic renewal, or contains an operating requirement.

Before admitting a supported record, compare it with the current position and the complete source. Ask whether the same matter has already been resolved, assigned, operationalized, or deliberately converted into a precondition, process, safeguard, benchmark, or scheduled review. If yes and no distinct matter remains, return no record. If the source cannot establish whether the matter remains open, use ambiguous_review rather than forcing support.
</semantic_contract>

<contrastive_examples>
- "Proceed only after the amendment is signed" is normally an adopted condition precedent, not an unresolved matter.
- "Pause after a privacy failure and decide separately before renewal" is normally an existing safeguard, not a newly discovered reopen condition.
- "At six months, review results and whether unwelcome information travels upward" is normally an operationalized review, not a separate reopen condition.
- "We still need a boundary process" may be unresolved earlier, but is not still unresolved if the final position states that disputed cases follow the written boundary process.
- A pilot limited to one supported setting can still leave a distinct transfer or generalization question when the current position does not establish what wider settings justify.
- Temporary support can create a distinct reopen condition when continuation would otherwise hide an unresolved steady-state burden.
</contrastive_examples>

<output_rules>
It is correct to return no_supported_record_observed with an empty array. Use records_present only for at least one supported record. Use ambiguous_review only for one or more ambiguous records and no supported record. Cite exact source aliases. Return schema-valid JSON only.
</output_rules>

{"aliases":[{"alias":"e001","speaker":"user","text":"We manufacture laboratory freezers, and one control board sits inside almost every sourcing argument we have right now.","text_sha256":"478c92b2f60cb7214c4ed2e2d9e9b5d37c9a93ba2e75dfdacaa07750cbf8da52","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e002","speaker":"user","text":"We buy it from two suppliers.","text_sha256":"8552acf4c0058e3599fe422db28a034a37d5c04b330482c456caaee26d662ed7","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e003","speaker":"user","text":"The larger one has about sixty percent of our volume, a lower defect rate, and no missed shipments to us.","text_sha256":"067bd1a09be62253973e7c030bc64c80df3ae4db997f6a960a61ef1fd5b720e9","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e004","speaker":"user","text":"It is offering an eighteen-month price reduction if we move nearly everything there.","text_sha256":"53c21766768f4ec95f2acd03d3371c0563f302c28126f09bae4bfee705da5a1a","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e005","speaker":"user","text":"The savings would pay for a reliability program we keep postponing.","text_sha256":"cef9f13af7d9c8fc61c16ce127fe0a5a7dad4272c3e2494c8c2a871c55c766fd","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e006","speaker":"user","text":"Operations wants fewer interfaces and less inspection variation.","text_sha256":"134eb6a81644fa8eed60a9cc9ac08497318bc3857a5475425ea79231690021e9","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e007","speaker":"user","text":"I hear “single point of failure” and become uneasy, but then quality shows me the defects created by maintaining two versions and finance shows me what the second source costs.","text_sha256":"7ce607bfc3778661a7bdf4595c225d0143bbe9a0bf5b1b4a1e2a34c4a02af49c","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e008","speaker":"user","text":"Paying more for worse present performance is not automatically resilience.","text_sha256":"c5a575f5d1ba912eba92b8762e966e1c23b923a514e280b2bcdf90a4272817b4","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e009","speaker":"user","text":"Concentrating a critical board is not automatically reckless.","text_sha256":"69f2c8fe236ceb19c4b145f7fca0b4cecc8999e62430566997898e8b32a9cb37","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e010","speaker":"user","text":"I need a way to compare the risks we actually have, not the slogans attached to them.","text_sha256":"8a5b17c17d7db539f802eedebb38a6946ed0f6b305dbcdbbab26c54e0880886b","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e011","speaker":"assistant","text":"Compare operating systems, not supplier count.","text_sha256":"d1fbe3eb82cd475979c9b599533d974d02180e886a24aabf4bc7f1e92caf37b6","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e012","speaker":"assistant","text":"Put quality, engineering effort, inventory, qualification, recovery time, and bargaining position beside the reliability work the savings would fund.","text_sha256":"1d8c4b20a23c65392cba3ce8284af04dd1f8fed98263441c786f40f3700fa2b9","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e013","speaker":"assistant","text":"A weak second source may still be improvable—or may only create the appearance of resilience.","text_sha256":"37785e48df39fdde4b5cf431a2370345d0312ae1b8866e34f50e558b20b2639f","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e014","speaker":"user","text":"Exactly.","text_sha256":"445ea76e0fecc22edfb57a2ca2be09cca64ca11a356ce23a5287505de22c9fc0","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e015","speaker":"user","text":"The smaller supplier caused two stoppages last year, and its board needs separate firmware tests and inspection.","text_sha256":"d2f852969bd24d31f6c97e5344763baa8274b9cb01fa9738e7e6dd14d4e170f9","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e016","speaker":"user","text":"Please do not count two supplier names as resilience.","text_sha256":"db6e62ff86e52e28f577aee2e8c87d57e02d674f9e5cd7ecdcee143c3fd8264a","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e017","speaker":"user","text":"The extra complexity has already created failures.","text_sha256":"885bc145065b9bd8994428dccd19671ca6dfdd4810a7008b0fbcf4f5424c160a","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e018","speaker":"assistant","text":"That corrects my framing.","text_sha256":"be21a76c8a38c60738b7da8ac89c54b745d8b4835af648c8a82bdd27ab2c0efd","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e019","speaker":"assistant","text":"Redundancy is not free insurance; it can add ordinary failure modes while protecting against a rarer interruption.","text_sha256":"283a16efe91f9fdf0833021f7a2b66e17735d74d88e185eeadb3d46a332a428b","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e020","speaker":"assistant","text":"Compare tested recovery options—usable inventory, design and tooling access, component alternatives, and the real time needed to raise another source—with the defects and engineering attention you already pay for.","text_sha256":"616a11aeaf1d7cb1f5eb5f2c34ef174a2260727125bcc19afc0b9681b96ded09","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e021","speaker":"assistant","text":"Also make the proposed reliability program concrete.","text_sha256":"8d328230b6a3e70bcb9dd6ce1f7457a2c70b0ee31ad41844c69c9f259556a359","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e022","speaker":"assistant","text":"If the savings prevent more serious freezer failures, that benefit belongs in the decision rather than being treated as an unrelated use of money.","text_sha256":"cee57d2427322278ee1c3a58684e9e19961c77e7ebd393a319ba4eae3c0ed778","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e023","speaker":"user","text":"The larger supplier will hold eight weeks of finished boards in a warehouse near our plant and give us quarterly access to its continuity plans.","text_sha256":"7cfbe0f38c89874277d5cb21ec8d7a5e3698ebc86d010dd598643a1d39645c04","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e024","speaker":"user","text":"It assembles in two facilities, but both use the same semiconductor and both receive it through the same regional distributor.","text_sha256":"15b9085c9e9bf7ea341b395c1a28d128675bc12f48375a5c65fcfabf02e8e896","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e025","speaker":"user","text":"It says that component is standard and available from several manufacturers.","text_sha256":"195fa2a84409850c82aea3ee96f298d82cfc16d0a0ac2dd39f11ffb2ec6fc1dd","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e026","speaker":"user","text":"Our engineers can keep the firmware interface documentation, but we do not own the board layout.","text_sha256":"e7e7948a4f85af1381a02634b2d476acd1e4ccf1be0f7d7bf940cf0bc9e769eb","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e027","speaker":"assistant","text":"Two assembly sites do not diversify a shared upstream dependency, while the nearby stock buys response time.","text_sha256":"0d123dfd5b59a5b048b2c2ab85b29324cc6b3fcd1f06ac7c2d13f11d2f87263e","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e028","speaker":"assistant","text":"Verify the semiconductor's true substitutability, allocation rights during shortages, warehouse ownership, insurance, and whether stored boards age or require updates.","text_sha256":"7fdc776afe9b5d0de47accff810b89ae08be1767120c5b7f128ed892fc240873","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e029","speaker":"assistant","text":"Keeping the interface reduces redesign time; lack of layout ownership means an emergency second source would still require engineering and qualification.","text_sha256":"8fc993e232d09f7888c00cf3f25c4b6934073eb6c9d896fbcb3ddcdfcea51a4c","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e030","speaker":"user","text":"We asked the smaller supplier whether it would remain qualified at ten percent of volume.","text_sha256":"6b4807bc48bffca01832e484503ecb1b261f70f444c3ca8ecda532f41e3e0478","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e031","speaker":"user","text":"It says that level is uneconomic, but it would accept twenty-five percent if we commit for a year and jointly fix the inspection failures.","text_sha256":"d0f7635a57d5831b3398f2d557aa50c0f4906af459c2d093b773b2532bbaca74","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e032","speaker":"user","text":"That would cut the projected savings almost in half.","text_sha256":"413772355c3a876862505b8924355c0dd6b4d9d22702350d7a2b5ae4c44bdd5d","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e033","speaker":"user","text":"Operations argues that a dormant backup is mostly theater anyway, and quality prefers either a meaningful improvement program or a clean exit.","text_sha256":"e063cff2608c1c561f95c20ba8e8e0741b97c85cfcdc30a89686447547361559","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e034","speaker":"assistant","text":"They are right that token volume can preserve a name without preserving capability.","text_sha256":"bef110a5e8c670fa97cc2886e6498a797901e394fe63fa28258f2a6b5573bdb8","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e035","speaker":"assistant","text":"Compare a seventy-five/twenty-five split with single sourcing plus a funded requalification plan.","text_sha256":"48087f50dfc76c5ed0d633ebb94ebae5ac4e1eb751f58b5b68540833d24534b3","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e036","speaker":"assistant","text":"For the split, predefine defect and delivery improvements and an exit if they do not occur.","text_sha256":"f63538a9e8fb6d89a9dc706b03adfbc8c2cc211a4b99b2644214a55966fc9c69","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e037","speaker":"assistant","text":"For single sourcing, establish who can build what alternative, with which files, tooling, components, and elapsed time—not merely a statement that another source could be found.","text_sha256":"13a69e23de9e9be94d7035bcf677f8b616a9a7488ad960f3c37d795c966be932","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e038","speaker":"user","text":"Finance modeled both paths.","text_sha256":"a7e10eeb2b1a0c3250e2291a0b279f38adae71693537bc5ed88564cfcdbe4ae8","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e039","speaker":"user","text":"The split still funds the most urgent reliability work, although not the full program.","text_sha256":"bef040dcffa370d2f2f37768d9f147655f5c01c4bdd968dd048cd03c8bc13cbf","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e040","speaker":"user","text":"The larger supplier agreed that the local inventory belongs to us once produced and can be moved if the contract ends.","text_sha256":"c5299920e04f8be309f20d9769a8e40d8424dbb7cd366f18b3d31dd4f658d865","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e041","speaker":"user","text":"The smaller supplier will let our engineer review its process monthly and credit the extra inspection cost until its defect rate reaches the agreed range.","text_sha256":"e056faec8ad78bd0d0d36cd11639fd70871280e1ae916afc3e8a2d6a13658657","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e042","speaker":"user","text":"Neither contract requires exclusivity.","text_sha256":"e21a946471bbf1746558dd14c7efafd00b7509e42bd2adf9348b286dbd845926","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e043","speaker":"assistant","text":"Those terms convert some abstract options into operating protections.","text_sha256":"be6378c58ca88e8ea869563147116567b77d6feb6de64f8a81ed127f4c850481","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e044","speaker":"assistant","text":"The split preserves live production knowledge and gives the smaller supplier enough volume to improve, while owned inventory cushions common disruption.","text_sha256":"b4472e2438249b52dd6eb0c465905ce3b5ad8d8963361c09e3ddc7bcf718f30f","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e045","speaker":"assistant","text":"Record the cost of engineering attention and set a decision date; otherwise the improvement program can continue indefinitely because diversification sounds virtuous.","text_sha256":"b43c7ca69eaec5048e3bfed7bf77af73a452fb5c7b4daeebaf0e42ba6419bfd5","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e046","speaker":"user","text":"I keep coming back to the same discomfort: we may be paying for a dramatic rescue while accepting small failures every month.","text_sha256":"8528a9b49e8bd5a5a034698146e2cd272db662a6f77b84586e1ad94472e4d0c5","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e047","speaker":"user","text":"We propose reviews at six and twelve months, an exit if the secondary misses quality or delivery, and a real recovery exercise—not a continuity-plan presentation.","text_sha256":"05200cb4fa631ea7a5124c06fbb44e687b6cfe18697ed601b4e08bcb4dbc9a41","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e048","speaker":"assistant","text":"That makes the insurance earn its cost.","text_sha256":"176341bde4969f3fda05f068e17c208f9ad540b66bcdfad2ecb2222c68285ab5","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e049","speaker":"assistant","text":"Define the thresholds and sampling rules before the first review, and ensure a single unusual batch cannot determine the entire result.","text_sha256":"a8f555bdb025733fe5629954045baab3e4e3506ac7fa0e9d3143993aa18da57c","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e050","speaker":"assistant","text":"The recovery exercise should include decision authority, transport of owned stock, firmware compatibility, and the time to validate a replacement board.","text_sha256":"18742be14e15c7e687ed9994128b19cc3d28892e0b60fd66d46b6ababa7f7e01","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e051","speaker":"assistant","text":"Its purpose is to reveal an unusable assumption while there is still time to repair it.","text_sha256":"183764a21db2d713ae1fc433cd1de682d057ef1faa34c0be0b0490e83de0aa47","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e052","speaker":"user","text":"I will recommend the seventy-five/twenty-five split for one year, with the joint quality plan, owned buffer stock, two fixed supplier reviews, and the recovery exercise.","text_sha256":"9564463c1ac64724641334a432ee01c1b90d0926a86b309bbf6e45f719f19332","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e053","speaker":"user","text":"The reliability program will start with its highest-risk items rather than waiting for every projected saving.","text_sha256":"299bef3b011d98bccfa33a67ef58b446b56c908c8b822073353ef5da00ae1d4f","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e054","speaker":"user","text":"If the secondary supplier fails the predefined thresholds, we will stop paying for a nominal backup.","text_sha256":"cf19c7740879dfd4e88b467d801e2841dc463108e5b35209902c13dc09aa3b7e","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e055","speaker":"user","text":"If it passes, we will have evidence that the extra complexity is controlled rather than simply hoping two sources are safer.","text_sha256":"52be27d5055f126a54ea779abefc018eefbcd53d355a9f69798a2ff548373a38","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e056","speaker":"assistant","text":"That is a defensible one-year structure because both sides now have to perform.","text_sha256":"df8bfab68d7c84903b057b4b1a49288063825460f77996a744f20b16e139618d","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e057","speaker":"assistant","text":"The secondary source must meet ordinary quality and delivery thresholds; the primary arrangement must provide owned, usable stock and a credible recovery path; and the reliability program begins even though the split reduces the headline savings.","text_sha256":"636349c67dd6a7f2e82f412f0d44460b62c8fca26a289b1453762b6a241158aa","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e058","speaker":"assistant","text":"Keep the six- and twelve-month reviews fixed and preserve the exercise exactly as it happens, including awkward failures.","text_sha256":"f3711ec1ab5f4c3e785cff5b0a1a1c8aecef94206fc879f70a1e5124d80edf2a","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e059","speaker":"assistant","text":"Otherwise each side will later reinterpret the same year: procurement will remember optionality, operations will remember variation, and finance will remember the discount that was left on the table.","text_sha256":"3dfacc5e707ce3202c538f0d4f1d2a598a5c92050155e608a28879471d911b28","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e060","speaker":"user","text":"The recovery exercise failed on the first try.","text_sha256":"2d591b2048b6779b94401c258d7455380d93b1cd2468f994ee51bafcb38720b7","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e061","speaker":"user","text":"Some stored boards had old firmware and did not pass the current diagnostic.","text_sha256":"b2b22b6a01d9165a4bc6d2a3a129b9664ca080e71561e9a3f754312b54f272f3","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e062","speaker":"user","text":"Engineering fixed it in a day.","text_sha256":"a512ca16849780e71ccde6d2f0e6d7a79328ab18b84b12765b6aa68d7374acfa","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e063","speaker":"user","text":"Operations calls that successful learning; quality says it proves eight weeks of stock is not eight weeks of usable protection.","text_sha256":"30e48631f202b7d1998b8ac2ca84fb510afeaa5e96446db86ef8742a2b8427c1","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e064","speaker":"user","text":"Both are right.","text_sha256":"20e9478f74d5082afea783de31ec710a8ad54f42ec6c7f74f52de0eb4e728bea","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e065","speaker":"assistant","text":"Record both the initial failure and recovery time.","text_sha256":"208bfb09b3ef31b641e7ccae825bbd834870c884d4b63ed71bfc460447178eb3","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e066","speaker":"assistant","text":"The exercise succeeded as learning and failed as proof of immediate usability.","text_sha256":"3daca8aceb42c668bfab82c21c9deddcf27c6b562a87ef08ae70501a6d50000a","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e067","speaker":"assistant","text":"Add firmware status to inventory controls, test a sample on a schedule, and decide how updates are applied without consuming the buffer.","text_sha256":"b089bcc6b7bf4dad5934a5f0f095f0b078f3094da1de07b797d7ed85636dc6dc","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e068","speaker":"assistant","text":"The corrected process can make the stock more credible, but do not erase the first result when reporting readiness.","text_sha256":"f9cbb8ec144a874f0ac5bbccde776c02db87fa2c8806cca2545668582e27b7ff","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e069","speaker":"user","text":"The primary supplier then asked for a rolling ninety-day forecast and first opportunity to quote any new board design.","text_sha256":"b850066af23787083379d58e7d4ddaf2fca8b67b3a1502a8316ceb90aaa6ea5c","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e070","speaker":"user","text":"It says the lower price assumes planning visibility and engineering continuity.","text_sha256":"fc566b54b004f918fe521c038bd97dbbc9287717d60142280de198a662e4d31e","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e071","speaker":"user","text":"The clause is not exclusive, but our procurement manager thinks it could make the supplier the default before alternatives are considered.","text_sha256":"79471d0195582d60d43c3f58970afb3a134c26214c8b1bd48dac00c46eb6a8b9","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e072","speaker":"user","text":"Finance says first opportunity costs nothing if we can reject the quote.","text_sha256":"e558a9f928f3b3154e0272a36cac688f0f2df892b35f85fb0dfa733c98fe0c1b","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e073","speaker":"assistant","text":"The cost is procedural rather than formal exclusivity.","text_sha256":"50d174dfc412344bd7e576608df185704b328dc2248baad2ebf7ac727616e5c4","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e074","speaker":"assistant","text":"Limit the response window, preserve the right to develop alternatives in parallel, and prevent confidential competitor designs from being disclosed.","text_sha256":"8bcba98a59606ea86633c3bb6f7591e5ca7d4f6a0cc68c9b0504cfe55b9eaa4f","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e075","speaker":"assistant","text":"Forecast visibility may improve supply, but specify which changes are binding and whether the supplier can reduce allocation when forecasts are wrong.","text_sha256":"b039ad5383ab3a03b971569eaeccbb806e3032bb20f81284995933efa603a437","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e076","speaker":"assistant","text":"A default can be useful while still being monitored as a source of path dependence.","text_sha256":"6f5b405568dece41fa58519ad9527a5f3c22fa829f845ceec45bddcf47adc3d7","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e077","speaker":"user","text":"At the six-month review, the smaller supplier met the defect threshold but required more of our engineer's time than expected.","text_sha256":"ecb59b8a7920e587b7772c590e4fb8d665f8b23ccd727db32e3cec45ed744b1f","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e078","speaker":"user","text":"Its team says the attention is why quality improved; our engineer says several fixes are now stable and the next six months should be lighter.","text_sha256":"02793cf3994f1723b9511141d3d4b7309ae5d4fcd7ae13838cd5fe1e5af1df4c","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e079","speaker":"user","text":"If we count all that time, the secondary source is more expensive than the contract comparison showed.","text_sha256":"53c3f9d4b17dfda9827e24da34843b1a2084def82585d3a433fb05a8f44ccf4a","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e080","speaker":"user","text":"If we treat the learning as a one-time investment, it may still be worthwhile.","text_sha256":"d18d5688dcda68b6e3c1f7e643e560b2771c3597707f2e16a4f9d111667dfc55","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e081","speaker":"assistant","text":"Separate recurring support from improvements that now transfer, then test whether effort actually falls.","text_sha256":"0471c14b9dac9db91c4bacb669506de9465fcbc4a596983650d1a27bd07e78b5","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e082","speaker":"assistant","text":"Hidden engineering subsidy is supplier cost too.","text_sha256":"fa77cd40fa4ab04956938e4bf6b848a3d81a5a260d1f264cf752a7b3f836fb84","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e083","speaker":"user","text":"And now the part that makes the original debate feel almost quaint: the shared semiconductor package will be discontinued in eighteen months.","text_sha256":"5d3543ba335851f0d6f892f3398ab707599fa93d6bdaf1236918353040363818","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e084","speaker":"user","text":"Both suppliers knew a change was likely, neither had the date, and both boards depend on it.","text_sha256":"3cd36e23b82dac8c5c45d5d38864f17bb39b46c3b2ee62862e2b6a39711e18bd","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e085","speaker":"user","text":"The primary wants to lead one common replacement design.","text_sha256":"c8bdc8d0950b0b04d6d2d785413961eaa33fd0b385df61dd98bf6e67d7f7d2b6","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e086","speaker":"user","text":"The secondary argues that a shared design recreates the same dependency and wants its
